place.raw: Oyster Bay, Nassau, Long Island, New York

notes: NAME REFINEMENT (research 2026-07-03): multiple independent compiled sources (WikiTree Cheesman-22/Stringham-7, genealogieonline.nl) agree Richard Cheesman Sr. married 'Hannah Stringham' on 10 Jan 1694. Her biological father was Joseph Halstead (d. 1679); her mother Susannah (Harcutt) Halstead remarried Peter Stringham after 1679, and Hannah was thereafter known under her stepfather's surname, Stringham — the name under which she married Richard Cheesman and by which she is recorded in nearly every published pedigree. Best rendered 'Hannah (Halstead) Stringham': 'Stringham' is not an error to replace 'Halstead' with, but a married/step-surname that should accompany it.
